outgoing.name: Coffee
outgoing.excerpt: The discoloration of teeth over time can result from exposure to substances such as tobacco, coffee, and tea .

outgoing.name: Drinking water
outgoing.excerpt: The recommended dosage of fluoride in drinking water is 1 part per million ( ppm) .

outgoing.name: Juice
outgoing.excerpt: Sugars from candies, soft drinks, and even fruit juices play a significant role in tooth decay, and consequently in enamel destruction.
